title: Nice trip with nice guide Petra
text:
We really enjoyed the trip. The botanical garden was beautiful — not very large, but a wonderful place for photos. Blanes is a charming and authentic little town, and we had a delicious lunch there.

Petra is such a lovely and thoughtful guide. She was always smiling and took the time to introduce each place we visited. With her, the whole experience felt very relaxed and enjoyable.

Thank you very much for the wonderful service.
author: J3756BYinesc

title: Wonderful
text: This was a wonderful tour. Our driver Laila was very kind and professional. The Winery tour felt relaxed and magical. the garden was beautiful and the City of Blane was purely Magical . I Love everything about this tour . Highly recommended
author: Asta_A
